name: The Sheet Metal Shop
old_description: Welcome to The Sheet Metal Shop, your trusted partner for precision sheet metal fabrication in Columbus, Ohio. We specialize in providing top-notch solutions for all your commercial and residential sheet metal needs with a commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.
about:
The Sheet Metal Shop operates from Columbus, Ohio, where it has built a reputation for precision sheet metal fabrication. The business is veteran-owned and family-owned, though its founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides a wide range of fabrication services, including plasma cutting, aluminum and stainless steel welding, custom ductwork, grease ducts, roof curbs, roof rails, structural framing, anti-theft security cages, fire wrap installation, and artistic metalwork. It works with stainless steel, aluminum, carbon steel, and black iron, serving both residential and commercial projects. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Its customer base spans construction, manufacturing, and HVAC sectors, with commercial and industrial clients throughout Central Ohio. The company also serves residential customers for custom metal artistry, HVAC components, and planters.

The company highlights its R-Stamp certification as evidence of adherence to industry standards, and emphasizes its veteran and family-owned legacy combined with state-of-the-art technology as key differentiators. It states that its commitment to quality, precision, and customer satisfaction sets it apart from other fabricators.
